title.narrative: Génesis GT: Senior Loan for MSMEs and Inclusive Portfolio in Guatemala

description.narrative: The Project consists of a senior unsecured loan of up to US$60 million or its equivalent in Guatemalan quetzals (the "Project" or the "Financing") to be granted to Fundación Génesis Empresarial ("Génesis"), with a term of up to five years from disbursement. IDB Invest's Financing will be composed of: (i) Tranche I: a senior committed tranche for up to US$40,000,000; and (ii) Tranche II: a senior uncommitted tranche for up to US$20,000,000. In addition, the Financing will have the possibility of mobilizing additional resources through B loans and/or co-financing. The resources of the Financing will be used to support the growth of Génesis' credit portfolio, expanding financial inclusion through a greater supply of credit for Micro, Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises ("MSMEs") and other populations in Guatemala, fostering the generation of economic opportunities and productive development.The Financing will be complemented with IDB Invest's Technical Advisory Services (“TA”) that may be focused on supporting Génesis in the identification, prioritization and design of an innovative financial health initiative with a social, environmental, and governance approach.
